rationale_overall: No removes: the H1-2022 growth-stock drawdown hit AAPL/MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA's prices but not their fundamentals — NVDA still posted record Q1 FY23 revenue of $8.29B (+46% YoY) on 2022-05-25 — and RKLB (May 2 helicopter booster-catch milestone) and LMT (May 2022 Javelin production ramp for Ukraine) both show their theses advancing, so this is a pure add quarter. Three adds fill named next-wave gaps: RGTI reinforces quantum alongside IonQ, SMR opens the nuclear/SMR leg with the first pure-play publicly traded SMR name, and STNG opens tactical tanker/freight exposure to the energy-geopolitical wave as Ukraine-driven rerouting lifts product tanker rates. Robotics was surveyed (BOTZ ETF, down ~43% YTD with no commercial inflection found in the window) but skipped this quarter for lack of a concrete catalyst; eldercare/demographics was also surveyed with no dated Q2-2022 catalyst strong enough to clear the bar.
